references.title: Asset library selection and filtering
references.question: Q1
references.take: Figma exposes an Assets panel with a search field, shared-library toggles, and grid/list layout controls before insertion.

references.title: Insert and configure a component instance
references.question: Q3
references.take: Figma’s flow explicitly previews component details, chooses a variable mode, inserts an instance, and keeps it linked to the source library.

references.title: Create and publish course
references.question: Q1
references.take: Teachable’s guided course wizard starts from an empty courses list and offers an outline method after collecting course metadata.

references.title: Course creation onboarding from empty state
references.question: Q6
references.take: The Teachable flow provides a concrete first-run path from an empty Courses list into a guided five-step setup.

references.title: Browse, preview, and copy a template
references.question: Q1
references.take: PamPam’s template journey moves from a creation menu to category browsing, a full template preview, and a prominent Copy action.

references.title: Copy template into a new editable map
references.question: Q3
references.take: PamPam describes template copying as a new map object with duplicated places and route, making the instance semantics explicit.

references.title: Template preview with live customization
references.question: Q1
references.take: Canva keeps suggested templates visible beside a selected canvas preview, then offers an immediate Use Canva Editor continuation.

references.title: Apply changes to a template instance
references.question: Q3
references.take: Canva’s flow applies palette changes to the selected design object and preserves it for continued editing in the editor.

references.title: Choose a course outline method
references.question: Q6
references.take: Teachable’s empty outline screen presents three clearly separated creation methods, making first-run choices scannable.

references.title: AI-assisted course outline workspace
references.question: Q5
references.take: Teachable’s outline workspace keeps curriculum creation inside the course context while exposing an AI outline action as an optional shortcut.

references.title: Filterable component library browser
references.question: Q1
references.take: Relume combines templates, cards, a search field, dropdown filters, and a sidebar to narrow a large component library.

references.title: Component details preview popover
references.question: Q1
references.take: Figma uses a focused details popup to inspect a reusable review-card component before committing it to the canvas.

references.title: Search with an explicit no-results state
references.question: Q6
references.take: MasterClass makes a failed library search explicit with a visible No results found message instead of leaving the course browser ambiguous.

references.title: Course content management shell
references.question: Q4
references.take: Gumroad’s course content screen anchors add and edit actions in a persistent sidebar and tabbed workspace, supporting section-level navigation.
